title: Empirica observer: one run's row (contract v1; the demo's rows.json holds them)
description: A run as the observer indexes it: the v1 row's facts plus standing, ask, asked_at, flags, mode and id.

gating.description: In the run's effective scope (its approval gates convergence).

blocker.description: The plugin's blocker reason code for a scoped claim that is not approved (a public-contract reason); null otherwise.

blocker_claim.description: The claim whose resolution the blocker waits on: this claim, or the supporting claim the plugin redirected it to (a claim blocked by an unresolved supporter carries that supporter's reason). Null exactly when blocker is null.

evidence.description: The strongest kind among the claim's active evidence: a spike, else research, else none.

review.description: The claim against the latest audit verdict: passed = reviewed with today's evidence by the current passing audit; failed = reviewed by a failing verdict; stale = reviewed with today's evidence by a pass that no longer binds the argument; changed = its evidence changed since it was reviewed; unreviewed = the verdict did not review it; none = no verdict yet.

assurance.description: Whether the claim is settled (core.observer.assurance): assured = approved, covered by a current passing audit, no re-audit pending; awaiting_audit = approved but not yet covered (no audit, a pass no longer current, its evidence changed since, or a re-audit pending); audit_failed = approved but a failing verdict reviewed it; not_approved = anything else.

coverage.description: How much of the store was read: every run, those read fully, those whose state is damaged (diagnostic unreadable) and those read only in part (any other diagnostic). runs = read + unreadable + partial. A consumer that shows a count of claims, decisions or attention states must say how many runs it could not read.

host.description: The host that started the run.

label.description: A short human name for the session; null (unknown) when the host recorded none.

locator.description: A copyable path or id that finds the session again; null (unknown) when the host recorded none.

interactive.description: Whether the host recorded the session as interactive (a person is at it); null (unknown) when it did not say. Not liveness.

delegated.description: Whether the host recorded the run as delegated (an unattended agent runs it). Not liveness.

auditSummary.description: The core's audit summary (core.projection._audit): four facts, never one overloaded word.

verdict.description: The latest recorded verdict, or none yet.

current.description: Whether that verdict still covers the current argument, goal and scope (false: a pass that no longer binds it); null with no verdict.

pending.description: A re-audit has been launched and has not settled.

independence.description: Independence of a settled verdict; null with no verdict or while a re-audit is pending.

run.description: The run id (the middle part of the key): runs that share it are attempts at the same session.

previous.description: The same run's previous generation, when the store has it.

started.description: When this generation was created: the time of its create write. Seconds since the epoch (UTC), as the bridge recorded it beside the run when that write landed (adapters/state/timeline.py, ADR-0070): a local label, unsigned, possibly skewed, never an order (attempts are ordered by generation, history by its own order). Null when that write's own timeline entry is missing, malformed or does not chain to the entry of the write before it: unknown, never zero, and never another write's time.

updated.description: When the run's current state was written: the time of the write that committed it. Seconds since the epoch (UTC), as the bridge recorded it beside the run when that write landed (adapters/state/timeline.py, ADR-0070): a local label, unsigned, possibly skewed, never an order but a page's (the summary's orders: every bucket but needs-a-human the most recent activity first; attempts are ordered by generation, history by its own order). Null when that write's own timeline entry is missing, malformed or does not chain to the entry of the write before it: unknown, never zero, and never another write's time.

ended.description: When the run ended: the time of the write that set its terminal status. Null while the run is active. Seconds since the epoch (UTC), as the bridge recorded it beside the run when that write landed (adapters/state/timeline.py, ADR-0070): a local label, unsigned, possibly skewed, never an order (attempts are ordered by generation, history by its own order). Null when that write's own timeline entry is missing, malformed or does not chain to the entry of the write before it: unknown, never zero, and never another write's time.

version.description: The cache version of this published row (not a plugin digest): it changes whenever anything the row was projected from changes, the state and history revisions, whether the prior generation is present, the run's timeline (its recorded times included, so a cached row never serves stale times) and, for a run with active spikes, the observation of the files they depend on. Never a time or a nonce itself (ADR-0070).

state.description: The plugin's run status; null when the state could not be read.

diagnostic.description: Why the observer could not read everything. unreadable: the state is not exactly the current state document (not decodable, another shape, or breaking the plugin's invariants); nothing is read from it. history-unavailable: no repository given maps to the run's project. history-missing: the repository given holds no history for this run. history-corrupt: the recorded history fails the plugin's checks. workspace-unavailable: the files its spikes depend on could not be observed (looked at again on every read). Null when fully read.

goal.description: The run's goal; null when the state could not be read. Search needs no detail fetch.

session.description: Where the session can be found again, as its host recorded it at StartRun; null when the state could not be read.

attention.description: needs_you: an active run for which the host will show a human a question at its next report (or an explicit one), whatever else the agent still owes first: whether a human is shown a form is the batch's own fact (core.confirmation.presentable), not the order of the gate. not_ended: anything else about a run that has not ended (the core knows nothing more: liveness is never inferred). ended: the run is terminal. Null when the run was not read.

next.description: What the run owes next, from detail.outstanding: the human's first reachable item when attention is needs_you, else the first item. Null when nothing is owed (the run ended, or its obligations are met) and when the run was not read fully.

audit.description: The core's audit summary; null when the history was not read.

root.description: The root claim's id; null when there are no claims, and when the claims were not read.

edges.description: Null when the history was not read: unknown, not none.

claims.description: Null when the history was not read: unknown, not none. An empty list is a run read in full that has no graph yet.

progress.description: How far the run's scoped claims are; null when the history was not read.

id.description: A run's compact id: the first hex digits of the sha256 of its key (application.observer_index.short_id).

standing.description: The one word a run is filed under (core.observer.standing), in precedence order: unreadable (not read in full), needs_human, audit_pending, changed_since_audit, not_ended, proven, then the stop's status.

ask.description: What a human is asked about an active run (core.observer.ask), read from the item the core presents; null when nothing is asked or the run was not read.

asked_at.description: When the pending ask was recorded: the time of the write that recorded it (the first of the batch's records or decision claims in history order, the shown terminal question, or, for a configuration, the write whose timeline entry first carries the waiting plan revision and proposal digest). Not when a dialog was shown, and not reset by a host restart. Null when unknown.

flags.description: The value-strip facts of the run: an audit failed, evidence refuted a claim, a human answered anything but later (decided: any item of the run's decisions, the one owner), or a pass no longer covers what it reviewed. Null when not read.

mode.description: The run's control mode (state.governance.control_mode); null when the state was not read.
